subject: F-11: DPI awareness and per-step screen scale
summary: The gate failure was a flaky test, not a code defect, and the gate is now green. The failing test, test_hook_callback_returns_instantly_even_when_processing_is_slow, uses the real pynput hook. A physical click at (1678, 783) landed while it ran and added a second step. I changed no code. A rerun of tests/test_recorder.py passed 11/11. The full gate then passed: ruff check clean, ruff format unchanged, pytest 719 passed, 5 skipped, 3 deselected. I did not run `py -3.12 -m capture --self-check` or any PyInstaller build. The uia-notes.md import-order note was NOT written. Bash and Edit were both denied mid-task ("don't ask" mode), so .claude/skills/uia-notes.md still has no DPI import-order section, and src/capture/__init__.py:6 still points to it. Needed text: capture/__init__.py calls set_process_dpi_awareness() before capture.tray/pynput import; never import pynput/mss/pywinauto/comtypes above it; sopforge.spec runtime_hooks stays empty; the recorder stores screen.scale; and the real-hook test is flaky if you click during it. The Screen.scale default-1.0 test already exists in tests/pipeline/test_manifest_loader.py:23, but that file is still uncommitted in the working tree.
